committee.sub: Morning brief · Friday 30 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Raw landing-page clicks sit at 72 since 6 Oct for $481.28 ex GST spent, near the roughly $6 per click test estimate, with $64.53 of the $600 credit left and zero qualified enquiries logged yet against that spend.

The change check came back clean this week, externalLast24h and externalLast7d both at 0, so nothing outside Chris's own edits is contaminating the test numbers right now. Impression share sits at 10% over 30 days with rank lost at 75.8% well above budget lost at 17.5%, so the ceiling is mostly auction rank, not spend, and that stays off the table while the test runs.

The page has been frozen since click 25 as planned. Of the 72 raw clicks since start, ask_cta_click shows 17 raw clicks on the primary question-form action versus 0 on review_cta_click, so visitors are engaging the lighter first step but not yet the deeper booking option.

AI Assistant sessions fell to 0 this week from 3 last week, and the chatgpt.com / ai-assistant source/medium pair also dropped to 0 from 3. Organic Search held flat at 9 sessions both weeks, still the only unpaid signal worth trusting since Direct (22, down from 36) is mostly Chris and untracked referrers.

actions.text: Update the RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads: they still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success, and need refreshing to match current site stats.
Logo and image assets are still outstanding for the serving ad groups; get these sorted when time allows.

weekly: 72 raw clicks logged since 6 Oct for $481.28 ex GST, $64.53 of the $600 credit left, and zero qualified enquiries recorded against 17 raw ask_cta_click events and 0 review_cta_click events.
55 last 7 days versus 69 the week before, a 20% fall, with visitors down from 66 to 43.
no generate_lead events and no form starts in the last 7 days; the one genuine enquiry from 23 Sept remains the only real candidate on record, still unverified against the qualified rule.

Paid Search rose from 19 to 23 sessions while Direct fell from 36 to 22 (not evidence of organic demand), LinkedIn stayed at 0 despite Chris posting there, and AI Assistant sessions dropped to 0 from 3, with the chatgpt.com referral also disappearing this week.

Search Console (through 27 Oct, lagging by two days) shows only 5 clicks from 176 impressions over 8 days, with the top page /simpro-xero-integration.html getting 75 impressions but 0 clicks at position 8.
